messages.content: Write a paragraph using words that contain only three types of vowels. How is the architecture for a stable diffusion model specified?

message.content: The text has a, e, and o. The form of a stable SD photo model has these parts: a net, a vae, and a text encoder. A vae maps a photo to a latent space. A text encoder maps words to marks. A net takes a step mark, a text mark, and a latent map. The net has blocks, self maps, cross maps, gates, norms, and paths. A step mark tells the net the age of a speckled scene. A text mark tells the net what to keep. The net learns to make a clean scene from a speckled scene. The net weaves maps on a low path and a top path. The net makes a clean map. A vae maps that clean map to a photo.
